pe139_curtis_davey_1989.note: Dedicated Curtis dossier: freshly retrieved publisher scan; selected printed 161 and 165 read with local OCR, and 161 visually collated. The named Foucault resource is Davey’s reading, not a new reading of Curtis’s 1988 book. Davey’s patriarchal-relations criticism is retained; no new Davey biography is inferred.

pe139_curtis_palmer_1993.note: Dedicated Curtis dossier: freshly retrieved publisher issue-reviews PDF, printed 365–367 re-read; printed 366 visually collated. First two PDF pages are review contents, so printed 365–367 correspond to PDF pages 3–5. Distinguish Palmer’s specific Curtis criticism and positive responsible-government qualification from his separate remarks on the Greer–Radforth collection; Curtis’s original book remains unread.

lof_christie_2009.note: Dedicated Curtis dossier: freshly retrieved institutional HTML; selected sixth essay paragraph, beginning Since liberalism was a response, checked for Christie’s explicit attribution of the governmentality point to Curtis. The precise Curtis text remains unidentified by Christie; no fresh reading of the 2009 Curtis chapter is claimed.

lof_fecteau_2009.note: Dedicated Curtis dossier: freshly retrieved institutional HTML; numbered discussion items 1–2 checked for Fecteau’s quotations of Curtis 2009 at 179 and 184, objecting to deterministic interest/identity/action and a single coherent liberal project. These are Fecteau’s mediated witnesses, not a fresh reading of Curtis’s chapter or McKay’s reply.
